title: Annotatio III §.X (5): Natura Sacramentorum — at least a triple assault on sacrament-nature
pass_a_gloss: (5.) By the Nature of the Sacraments, under at least a triple name.
pass_b_english: (5) Transsubstantiation assaults the Nature of the Sacraments under at least three heads.
Strimesius marks the assault as at minimum triple — three named wounds to what a sacrament is.
source_text: (5.) Natura Sacramentorum, nomine ad minimum triplici.

lemmas.gloss: under at least a triple name

choices.english: under a triple name / in three ways
